## Description

Linearizes non-linear sovereign bond yield curve dynamics using Koopman operator dictionary expansions, applying Model Predictive Control (MPC) to optimize fixed income arbitrage and immunization strategies.

## Where it may fit

Central bank interest rate shocks, yield curve twist/steepening events, fixed income relative value arbitrage.

## Vehicles

Fixed Income Arbitrage Funds, Global Macro Hedge Funds, Interest Rate Derivatives Desks.

## Required data

Multi-tenor sovereign bond yields, interest rate swap curves, macroeconomic inflation expectations.

## Caveats

Observable dictionary expansion requires L1 regularization to prevent overfitting across tenors.
